Need to include Haryanavi 
language in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.

Need
 to provide proper and adequate remuneration to fishermen of  Lakshadweep.

Need to raise the import 
duty on rubber.

Need for
early commencement of work relating to development of LNG Terminal at
Gangavaram Port in Andhra Pradesh.

Need to honour Anna 
Hazare, Social activist with Bharat Ratna.

Need to run a train between Bhubaneswar 
and Delhi via Keonjhar, Banaspani and Chaibasa.

Need to provide civil service aspirants
 who opted for  regional vernacular language three additional attempts as a one
time measure.

Need
 to protect Universities from interference.

Need to provide urgent central assistance 
for Athikadavu-Avinashi flood canal scheme in Tamil Nadu.

Need to withdraw service tax on 
all life insurance premiums.

Need 
to amend section 124A of the Indian Penal Code.

Need to accord early approval for change of alignment of the proposed new
broad gauge line from Nalgonda to Marchela in Andhra Pradesh.

Need to appoint Programme
 Officer for programmes running under Integrated Child Development Services
Scheme in Ahmedabad and Surat in Gujarat.

Need to start construction 
of sanctioned road projects and  resume construction work of various roads
under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana in Sheohar parliamentary constituency,
 Bihar.

Need to accord sanction to
 the proposal of Government of Maharashtra for construction of dam on Girna
River.

Need to formulate a 
comprehensive programme to check dwindling farm production due to climatic
change.

Need to construct a
permanent building for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya No. 2, Japla, Palamu
district, Jharkhand.

Need to upgrade State 
Highways in Naxal affected areas in Bihar.

Need to provide toilet facilities in all
 the households in villages declared as Nirmal Gram.

Need to examine meticulously the emission rate of
electro-magnetic radiation by mobile towers in the country.

Regarding development of
 strategic projects in Deoghar, Jharkhand.

Need to send a team of
agriculture scientists to Sitapur district, Uttar Pradesh to suggest ways and
means to increase groundnut production in the district.

Need 
to set up Centres of Skill Development in Maharajganj Parliamentary 
Constituency, Bihar.

Need to 
provide reservation on social and economic grounds.

Need to increase the number
of work days under Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme.

Need to release a
commemorative stamp in honour of Jhala Manna, the great hero and loyal
associate of Maharana Pratap.

Need to construct slip lane and service road on National Highway No. 76
passing through Bassi area in Chittorgarh parliamentary constituency,
Rajasthan.

Need to conduct an inquiry into alleged
irregularities in appointment of teachers in Indian Institute of Technology,
Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

Introduction of the Election 
Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2016.
Election of 20 Members from Lok Sabha and 10 Members from Rajya Sabha to the Committee on Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

Election of 15 Members from Lok Sabha and 07 Members from Rajya Sabha to the
Committee on Public Undertakings.

Election of the 15 Members from Lok Sabha and 07 Members from Rajya Sabha to
the Committee on Public Accounts.
Election of 30 Members from Lok Sabha to the Committee on Estimates.
Presentation of the 25th Report of the Business Advisory Committee.

Presentation of the 27th Report of the Standing Committee
on Finance on the Subject ''Non-Performing Assets (NPAs) of Financial
Institutions'' of the Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services).

Presentation of the 12th, 13th and 14th Reports of the Committee on
Estimates.

Secretary-General laid the Bills passed by the Houses of Parliament during
the 6th session of 16th Lok Sabha and assented to by the President.
Papers laid on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.

The Speaker made reference to the sad 
demise of His Excellency Shri Sushil Koirala, former Prime Minister of Nepal
and the President of the Nepali Congress.  She also made reference to the sad
demise of Dr. Balram Jakhar, former Speaker, Lok Sabha.  She further made
reference to the passing away of Shri Yashpal Singh, member, 8th Lok Sabha;
Shri Noorul Huda, member, 5th Lok Sabha; Shri Mufti Mohammed Sayeed, member,
9th and 12th Lok Sabhas; and Smt. Shanti Devi, member, 6th and 8th Lok Sabhas. 
She also made reference to the loss of lives of 7 security personnel and
injuries to 20 others in a terrorist attack at Pathankot Air Force Station on
02.01.2016 and loss of lives of 10 soldiers of the Indian Army due to avalanche
in Siachen, Jammu & Kashmir.

Announcement regarding amendments to Motion of Thanks on President's 
Address.

Secretary-General laid a
 copy of the President's Address to both the Houses of the Parliament assembled
together on the 23rd February, 2016.
